packageRules.description: Drop the base preset's blanket per-manager groups so each update gets its own PR and tier label. A group mixes update types, so claude-gate would win over patches and one major would block the rest
Put typescript-eslint back in one PR. The rule above also drops Renovate's monorepo group, and the plugin peers on the exact same parser version, so bumping one alone fails the lock file update
@grafana/eslint-config 9 peers on eslint-plugin-react-hooks >=7, so take both majors in one PR. The new react-hooks rules may need lint fixes on that branch
@grafana/* 13.2+ peers on react >=19 and we ship React 18 for Grafana 11.6+. Raise grafanaDependency first, then lift this cap
@grafana/eslint-config 10+ needs eslint-plugin-react-hooks >=7.1.0, which we have not adopted yet
Use chore(deps) for all updates so release-please keeps dependency bumps out of the changelog

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Carve security updates out of the blanket chore(deps) rule: fix(deps) is changelog-visible and bumps the patch version, so CVE fixes produce a release PR
